items.headline: Albemarle Corporation to Release Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026
items.snippet: Albemarle will release Q3 2026 earnings on Wednesday, November 4, 2026.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized the tight lithium market due to strong demand in EVs and stationary storage, with supply lagging demand. The company maintained its overall 2026 outlook, expecting to perform at the high end of scenario ranges. $100 million in run-rate savings achieved year

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: Albemarle shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months, underperforming the industry and the S&P 500's 13.9% increase. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on ALB stock amid softer China EV demand, elevated inventory and expected supply from mine restarts.

items.headline: [US Feature Stocks] Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership on the final day of negotiations ahead of a strike; the deal must be ratified by member vote. If the strike is averted, the risk of prolonged supply disruption is resolved.

items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: Chinese EV sales fell 13% in H1 2026 after subsidy withdrawals, yet global lithium consumption jumped 45% through May. Stationary storage is driving the gap. US Commerce imposed a one-year block on exports of lithium-ion battery black mass on Aug. 6.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Lithium producers from China to Australia have seen profits soar as demand from the energy storage sector pushes prices higher, per Bloomberg. Tianqi and Ganfeng posted their strongest first-half net income in three years. Spot lithium prices surged 22% this year so far. Albemarl
